The '''Ithori system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" />

In [[138 ABY]], as part of [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]]'s plans to build a galaxy-spanning network of communication arrays, [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] was overseeing the construction of a [[Ithori system secondary communications array outpost|secondary communications array outpost]] in the system.<ref name="Legacy 2013 2" />
